findings.body: The re-run request's exit status is ignored. `repo.run` returns a CompletedProcess without raising on failure (src/forge/repo.py:66–74), so a rejected `gh run rerun` request enters the attempt-wait loop, waits up to 600 seconds, and stops with the re-run refusal instead of returning False and starting a fix round. Item 4 explicitly requires failed gh calls to count as unmet eligibility. Check each request's returncode and add a command-level test for a rejected re-run request.
findings.title: Not done: A failed check is re-run once only when its failure names none of the change's files and the tests already passed on this machine.

findings.body: This adds an automatic re-run step and a new refusal directing the coordinator to retry `forge land`, but neither coordinator template changes. AGENTS.md:53–55 requires a change to “a step in the flow” to update `src/forge/templates/skill.md` or `src/forge/templates/brief.md` in the same change. The existing land guidance at src/forge/templates/skill.md:404–405 covers judging findings and running workers, but does not explain this new stop and retry path. Update the template to cover the automatic re-run and its refusal.
findings.title: Update coordinator guidance for the new re-run step
